capabilities: Show the active note's token count in the status bar
Compare GPT, Qwen, DeepSeek, Claude, and Gemini counts via hover
Choose the primary tokenizer in settings
Count note text only, excluding embedded images and attachments
extras: Desktop-only; Claude and Gemini counts are local estimates, not provider-exact; all counting is offline with no telemetry, account, or payment.
problem: Obsidian's status bar word count does not tell you how many LLM tokens a note would consume.
summary: Status bar plugin that shows a local token count for the active note, with per-model tokenizer comparison on hover.
